items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1962-02-10
items.q: With Johnny St. Cyril, we have a lot of… Yes. Doc Suchon. And some of those groups.

ctx.x: Yes. And then I have been down there with Joe Merez on a lot of… with a lot of groups.
Other groups too. That's right. With Johnny St. Cyril, we have a lot of… Yes. Doc Suchon. And some of those groups.
I've been on quite a few sessions.

items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: I sang on a record. I think it was one of Joe Moray's records. Dr. Sushan. Dr. Sushan had that session, yes.

ctx.x: And you sang on one record then.
Yes, I sang on a record. I think it was one of Joe Moray's records. Dr. Sushan. Dr. Sushan had that session, yes.
You know, he studied under that Watson fellow. Who did? Dr. Sushan. Who did? Dr. Sushan. He did. Eddie watched the other day?
